name: burner
description: Live session cost odometer above the prompt: a burning fuse, real-world comparisons, threshold alerts

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, the pane, the toasts and /burn: id (Bahasa Indonesia) or en (English)

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: What money shows in: idr (Rp), usd ($), or auto to follow the language. Display only: costs, thresholds and totals are counted in dollars

comparisons.title: Comparisons
comparisons.description: What the spend is compared to: us (burritos, McDoubles), id (nasi padang, bakso, es teh manis), or auto to follow the language

exchangeRateApiKey.title: ExchangeRate-API key
exchangeRateApiKey.description: Free key from exchangerate-api.com for the live rupiah rate (rupiah money and the Indonesian foods), fetched once per new session and cached; overrides idrPerUsd. Falls back to the EXCHANGERATE_API_KEY environment variable

idrPerUsd.title: Rupiah per dollar
idrPerUsd.description: Manual rupiah per dollar, for rupiah money and the Indonesian foods, when no ExchangeRate-API key is set
